behavior: With declare_unreviewed on, an ignored-only PR gets the label and the rationale section, idempotently, and a stale label is cleared. With it off, only the notice is printed.

The reusable workflow's interface: workflow_call, explicit secrets, no secrets: inherit, no branch literals, no github.workflow_sha, checkout of its own commit, the Anthropic provider env, and the pr-number artifact.
The push-gate composite action fails the step when its script errors.
hive calls the reusable workflow pinned by a full SHA.
Over seven days, every hive run names its drawn member, and every run whose NaN preflight fails is reviewed by Haiku.
Caller fixtures shaped like kubelab, dotfiles and hive match the workflow's inputs and secrets without any change to it.
